story.head: Brink returns to Philadelphia
paras: The Flyers are winless in three (0-2-1), and the Wild (9-3-3) lost 4-3 in overtime to the Islanders on Thursday. Going in, the Wild are first in the Central (second in the NHL) and the Flyers last in the Metropolitan (tied for 28th).

The Wild leave the shooting to their forwards (3rd lowest), let the point shots come and guard the net (3rd) and get pinned in their own end on long shifts (31st). Minnesota has allowed 2.33 goals a game, the third fewest in the league. The Flyers play slow, tight games (2nd lowest) and pick their shots (3rd lowest). They also get a lot of their shots blocked (30th), so the Wild are likely to get in the way of a lot of their shots. Philadelphia has scored 1.93 goals a game, the fewest in the league. The Wild are likely to get plenty of pucks to the net against the Flyers.

Kirill Kaprizov (14 G / 10 A / 24 P in 15 GP) leads the Wild in scoring and is tied for second in the NHL, with seven points in his last five games. Quinn Hughes (4 G / 16 A / 20 P in 15 GP) isn’t far behind, with seven points in his last five games. For the Flyers, Trevor Zegras (4 G / 9 A / 13 P in 15 GP) leads the way in scoring, with nine points in his last five games. Matvei Michkov (9 G / 2 A / 11 P in 15 GP) has a team-high nine goals, tied for seventh in the NHL.

Jesper Wallstedt (8-2-3 / .916 SV% in 13 GS) has been a rock in net for Minnesota and will likely start. Philadelphia has two options in net: Joseph Woll (1-5-2 / .899 SV% in 8 GS) and Dan Vladař (2-3-2 / .888 SV% in 7 GS). They have split the last ten starts, and Woll got the last one on Wednesday. It’s anyone’s guess who gets the net.

At home, Rick Tocchet likes to send Zegras, Dvorak and Knuble out against the other team’s top line, so watch for them against Kaprizov, Ek and Boldy. Elsewhere, the Wild usually control more of the chances than the Flyers do.

items.text: Bobby Brink faces Philadelphia for the first time since leaving.

The Wild are newly without Jared Spurgeon and Joel Eriksson Ek, have been without Marcus Foligno since Oct 8, and have had to make do without Filip Gustavsson and Brock Faber all season. Jesper Wallstedt is expected to start. Taking into account how much value each of these missing players usually adds, only the Kings are missing more right now.
The Flyers are newly without Rasmus Ristolainen, and have been without Owen Tippett and Travis Konecny for several games.
Sean Couturier has four goals in six games against Minnesota since 2023-24.
